name: Nasrin
source:
A Peladonian woman from across the sea, she specializes in both trades that corrupt and indulgent society is infamous for: murder and prostitution. She's never stayed in one place for very long, but in the course of her travels she found herself in Valerius's employ, and hasn’t left him since. As far as Valerius can tell, it seems that she stays around for the opportunity to tease him as much as for the gold he pays for her work. Now she serves as the go-between for Valerius and Clodia, posing as a slave to sneak his messages into the city for her.

[From [url=https://www.basileusgames.com/]official website[/url]]
